data.name: label1.Text
data.value: - The player must determine whether the given equation is True or False based on the provided Truth Table. - The equation will adjust depending on the player's score. - Single Propositions are automatically negated, e.g., -q, -p, -r. - Double Propositions include expressions like q^r, r^p. - If the score is less than 8, one equation consisting of double propositions will drop. - If the score is between 8 and 20, two equations will drop simultaneously, one consisting of single propositions and one consisting of double propositions. - If the score exceeds 20, three equations will drop simultaneously, one consisting of single propositions and two consisting of double propositions. - If the score surpasses 30, three equations will drop simultaneously, consisting of negated double propositions. - if you get 7 score streak as indicated in the progress bar you will heal 1 health but if your health is full then it will give you extra points
